title: Truman's Hideout Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Truman’s Hideout is located off Quincy Circle, Santa Rosa Beach, FL, 32459, on the 2nd Floor, in the upscale community of Seaside. Truman’s Hideout is only steps away from the many shops of Seaside, the amphitheater, and directly across 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 30 Second walk to the town square in Seaside - Access to the Seaside private beaches at George and Coleman pavilions - Up to 4 Wrist Bands TOTAL for beach access (per Seaside guidelines they will not provide us with more bands than the home sleeps) - 2 Adult sized beach cruiser bikes - One reserved parking spot - Across the street from the beach - Gas Grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -**Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($100 fee applies at booking). Truman’s Hideout is located off Quincy Circle, Santa Rosa Beach, FL, 32459, on the 2nd Floor, in the upscale community of Seaside. Truman’s Hideout is only steps away from the many shops of Seaside, the amphitheater, and directly across 30A from one of Seaside’s beach accesses and the famous Bud & Alleys Restaurant. Truman’s Hideout is a 2BR/2BA condo with elevator access that sleeps 4 comfortably. As you enter the condo you walk into a spacious living room that has an open kitchen (bar seating for 3 only). There is a stackable washer/dryer are hidden in a closet just before the hallway. The hall bathroom has a stand-up shower used by the Queen Master bedroom and across the hall is the second bedroom with full size mattresses on both top and bottom bunk. This room also has its own private full bath. ACCOMMODATIONS: Bedroom 1: Queen bed, Hallway bathroom with stand-up shower, TV Bedroom 2: Double bed Bunks (sleeps up to 4) with full private bath- shower/tub combo, TV Living area and kitchen ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. Sorry, no pets! Must be 25 to rent FREE WiFi

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
